design_rule: A module belongs in the stable kernel only when removing its interface changes a protected downstream scientific decision. Parent algorithms and transparent reference methods remain adapters/baselines.

families.name: identity_contracts_receipts
families.downstream_role: bind problem, scope, obligations, resources, authority and immutable identities before scientific actions

families.name: plural_scientific_state
families.downstream_role: retain live obligations, alternatives, uncertainty and typed non-success without premature collapse

families.name: context_relative_relations_and_transport
families.downstream_role: state which relation/transport is claimed, under which context/probes/epoch/tolerance, with witnesses, losses and expiry

families.name: evidence_dependence_provenance_revalidation
families.downstream_role: preserve evidence identity, dependence, multi-parent lineage, assumptions, authority ceilings and selective invalidation reach

families.name: solver_action_diagnosis_recovery
families.downstream_role: generate/select admissible actions, diagnose plural responsibility, execute under constraints, repair/compensate/retry and preserve non-compensatory gates

families.name: frontier_and_escalation
families.downstream_role: propose frontier opportunities and change solving level only after witnessed incumbent insufficiency and with external agenda/adoption authority

families.name: evaluation_parity_saturation_authority
families.downstream_role: bind protected evaluators, V1 parity, donor-product comparison, saturation, failures and closeout without minting scientific authority

parent_or_reference_modules.role: research validation, not a universal kernel primitive

unresolved_duplicate_groups.required_disposition: one stable request/receipt interface; parent/reference implementations remain namespaced adapters
separate evidence dependence from provenance lineage while sharing one invalidation/revalidation contract
one action/diagnosis/recovery interface; parent algorithms remain replaceable
keep opportunity proposal, portfolio selection and escalation as distinct states but avoid duplicate authority/score semantics

freeze_requirements: all seven kernel families have a protected downstream role
all 59 frozen V1 capabilities map to at least one kernel or registered parent adapter
reference-only parent methods are not exported as universal V2 primitives
simple-control parity penalizes unnecessary kernel complexity
no kernel interface self-grants scientific truth, novelty or adoption
